low_ipm_exclusion.rationale: Near-zero pile of 398 shots (12.5% of xray-on) with ipm2c<200; photon_px median 41 vs 7205 normal; normalization planned so exclusion mandatory

high_ipm_exclusion.rationale: Baseline convention p99 cut: 32 shots dropped (ipm2>31221); ratio ~24 at top vs ~21 mid-range (slight upturn); matches human baseline

normalization.rationale: Chrono-bin CV 13.02%->3.13% with ratio_of_sums; per-shot division harmful (13%->16.6%) due to biased ratio below ipm2c~3000; r(det,ipm2c)=0.89; ratio_of_sums chosen because 200-3000 mid-band kept per operator hint
